guitar.notes: Steve Howe's Gibson ES-175 is iconic and extensively documented prog-rock guitar gear, used throughout Yes's classic era.

tone.target: bright gated 80s synth-rock guitar with chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright gated 80s synth-rock guitar with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A tight signal chain using compression and a mild overdrive into an AC30-style amp, enhanced with chorus and short delay to capture the polished, gated synth-rock sound of the 1980s.
corrections: keep it tighter than generic chorus rock
